description:
The usability container's one linked artifact is archived through the archival execution path, closing the last artifact REQ-09 ranges over.

## Background

`41d07c6b` (Epic: Usability Improvements) is terminal and sits outside this epic's own subtree, and its story `fdb039ee` links `dev/active/fdb039ee-modular-document-rendering.md`. The container was not among the 24 archival executions because its whole archivable content is that one artifact and the planner retained it: the document reference carries a commit pin, and a pinned reference is retained by design.

The pin has no recorded purpose. It was written by `fe7667ed`, the commit that created that issue structure, rather than by a decision to hold the document at a historical version, and no committed script reads the path at runtime — the condition that motivated the deliberate pins `d9e70703` placed on the two `dev/studies/perf` records.

The epic's independent holistic review read REQ-09 literally and found the artifact unarchived. REQ-09 states no commit-pin exception, so the criterion is closed by archiving the artifact rather than by amending the criterion. Owner-approved.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The document reference from `fdb039ee` to the modular-renderer design carries no commit pin.
- [hard] REQ-02: Container `41d07c6b` is archived through `jit archive container --execute`, and the artifact resides under the configured archive root with its reference resolving to the new path.
- [hard] REQ-03: No artifact owned by a terminal issue outside this epic's own subtree remains under `dev/active`.
- [hard] REQ-04: Whole-repository validation passes afterwards with every document reference in the repository resolving.
title: Archive the usability container's pinned modular-renderer artifact
